background: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation is HSBC's founding bank and its largest, the leading bank in Hong Kong and the group's platform across Asia, funded by a very large base of Hong Kong dollar deposits.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, AA- on average and all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. CET1 of 17.0% and NSFR of 142% are in the top quarter of Asian banks, while leverage of 5.4% and LCR of 138% are below the median. Every ratio has fallen since 30 Jun 2025, CET1 by 0.9 points, leverage by 0.4 points, LCR by 24 points and NSFR by 10 points (figures to 30 Jun 2026), though from a strong starting point.
